messages:
maria (support): Hey team, Acme reported a big mismatch between what they see in the dashboard and the invoice for Mar billing cycle. Dashboard shows ~12,420,000 gen tokens, invoice line shows 13,920,000 tokens for the same project and period (INV-2026-03-ACME). They flagged a +1.5M token delta and want a breakdown. :eyes:
kevin (billing): Can you paste the invoice line and the dashboard slice link? Also need customer project_id and the billing window you used to compare.
maria (support): Invoice: INV-2026-03-ACME line: "standard-generation" qty=13,920,000 tokens, unit_price=0.0006. Dashboard slice: Projects/ACME_Corp > Mar 1 - Mar 31, model: rwd-standard-1. Project id: proj-acme-77. Comparison window: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z. Dashboard export attached (CSV snippet below).

maria (support): CSV snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:02Z,proj-acme-77,rwd-standard-1,24000,182,evt_1a2b3c
2026-03-15T14:12:05Z,proj-acme-77,rwd-standard-1,48000,364,evt_1a2b3d
2026-03-20T09:20:10Z,proj-acme-77,rwd-standard-1,64000,486,evt_1a2b3e
```

jamal (eng-infra): Noted. Two quick suspects: 1) mid-cycle plan change/proration causing duplicate attribution between tiers, 2) metering pipeline duplicate events during pod failover. Any recent deploy or incident?
maria (support): Customer says they did a plan change on 2026-03-11 but it was to higher tier (shouldn't create extra tokens). No known incident in status page for that window.
kevin (billing): If plan change was on 3/11, we should check for split-line attribution. But that usually affects pricing, not raw token counts. Did you check for event dedupe? Our invoice generator dedupes by event_id but only inside a batch window. If duplicates have different event_ids they could be double counted.
jamal (eng-infra): Can you grep for events with same request_id but different event_id? I suspect streaming/batched requests might produce multiple metering events with same request_id when a connection reset happens. Run this query against metering-store: 
```
SELECT request_id, COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) as evt_count, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM metering.events
WHERE project_id='proj-acme-77' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) > 1
ORDER BY tokens_sum DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

maria (support): Running now on the exported slice, first pass shows ~320 request_ids with evt_count=2, top ones sum to ~1.4M tokens. Attaching a tiny log sample:
```
2026-03-11T02:13:09Z request_id=req-A3 event_id=evt_9f8a tokens=120000 status=ok
2026-03-11T02:13:09Z request_id=req-A3 event_id=evt_9f8b tokens=120000 status=ok
```
tia (finance): If those duplicates are real events we should not bill twice. How does invoice pipeline dedupe? If it only dedupes within a single ingestion batch ID, duplicates across retries might slip through.
kevin (billing): Right — dedupe uses event_id as primary key. If we have two different event_ids for same request we won't dedupe. We need to decide: 1) mark duplicate events as retries and exclude them, or 2) run a one-off backfill that collapses by request_id for that billing period.
jamal (eng-infra): I'm going to run a quick check on the metering pipeline logs for the 3/11 window; pinging @sre-oncall for help locating pod restarts.
sre-oncall: Looking now. There was a brief autoscaler bounce in cluster-gpu-1 at 2026-03-11T02:12:50Z that triggered streaming-worker restarts (related to kubelet OOM kill on node-22). We saw connection retries from the workers at 02:13:08-02:13:20Z. Could produce duplicated client events. :thinking:

jamal (eng-infra): Confirmed. I found a batch of ~1.47M tokens where the same request_id has 2 event_ids; they line up exactly with the restart window. We should treat event pairs with identical request_id+tokens+model+ts-window as retries and exclude the later one. I can draft a backfill.
kevin (billing): Good. Please create a deterministic rule (prefer earliest event_id per request_id in that time window) and produce an audit-ready diff so finance can reissue corrected invoice.
tia (finance): Also need a customer-facing explanation and audit log for legal. If we reissue, do we credit them the difference or void/reissue? Let's wait for diff size.
maria (support): I will message Acme with a "we're investigating" update and let them know there's a potential ingestion retry issue.
jamal (eng-infra): Action items: 1) I'll run backfill that collapses duplicates by request_id for 2026-03-01..2026-03-31 and produce CSV of removed event_ids (ETA 2h). 2) Billing will hold invoice adjustment until audit diff posted. 3) SRE will add a detection rule for similar restart windows.
sre-oncall: Adding alert: if worker restart rate > 5/min and duplicate request_id ratio > 1% then page.
kevin (billing): Once we have the CSV diff, finance: prep credit memo template. Maria: please draft customer note and attach timeline.
maria (support): Drafting now, will post to thread for review. Thanks all. :pray:
